column1: # mapping_set_description: Independent DataCite 4.7 term correspondences to Dublin Core Terms and DCMI Type. Overlap
#   with other target sets is intentional. SKOS relations express term correspondence, not executable record conversion.
#   Qualifier dispatch and structural transformations are documented in conversion/dcterms.json.
# comment: Curated from source definitions and official target documentation.
#   Wikidata evidence is a dated lookup, not an immutable vocabulary release.
